Dear [Mr Craik](/person/379)
They have only sent me the first 19 columns of the [French primer](/book/353), which I had [illegible] and which only want a little correction of the [illegible].

What I want is the latter half which I know was once set up, but which has not been lengthened, as this earlier part has been

Yours truly

C M Yonge


[^1]: Black-edged paper.
